questions.question: Which <meta> tag configuration is essential to ensure responsive rendering across mobile screens?
questions.explanation: The viewport meta tag matches the virtual viewport to physical device width at 1:1 initial scale.

questions.question: Which HTML tag supplies the summary snippet displayed beneath your page title on Google search results?
questions.explanation: Search engines inspect <meta name='description'> to populate the organic search results snippet.

questions.question: What core performance dimension does Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) measure in Google Core Web Vitals?
options: Time to First Byte (TTFB) from the hosting server
Render time of the largest visible content element in the viewport
Duration taken to parse inline JavaScript tags
Frequency of jarring DOM repositioning during scrolling
questions.explanation: LCP benchmarks perceived loading speed by recording when the primary hero content finishes rendering.

questions.question: What is the primary cause of poor Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) on educational web pages?
options: Images and dynamic media embedded without explicit width and height dimensions
Loading external CSS from a Content Delivery Network (CDN)
Using CSS Grid and Flexbox simultaneously
Omitting the charset meta tag in <head>
questions.explanation: Images without explicit dimensions force browser reflows as assets load, causing jarring layout jumps.

questions.question: Which Chrome DevTools tool automates auditing for Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO?
questions.explanation: Google Lighthouse delivers structured audits and performance scores directly within Chrome DevTools.

questions.question: What is the recommended threshold for Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) to achieve a 'Good' Core Web Vitals rating?
questions.explanation: Google defines an LCP of 2.5 seconds or lower as 'Good', 2.5-4.0s as 'Needs Improvement', and >4.0s as 'Poor'.

questions.question: Which attribute on elements is critical for crawler comprehension and screen-reader accessibility?
questions.explanation: The 'alt' attribute conveys image semantics to search engine indexers and assistive screen readers.

questions.question: In Google Core Web Vitals, which metric replaced First Input Delay (FID) in March 2024, and what is its target threshold?
options: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) with a threshold of <= 200 milliseconds
First Contentful Paint (FCP) with a threshold of <= 1.0 second
Time to Interactive (TTI) with a threshold of <= 3.8 seconds
Total Blocking Time (TBT) with a threshold of <= 100 milliseconds
questions.explanation: In March 2024, Google officially replaced FID with Interaction to Next Paint (INP) as a Core Web Vital to measure the responsiveness of all clicks, taps, and keypresses with a recommended target of <= 200ms.

questions.question: Which protocol of meta tags formats preview cards when pages are shared across social channels?
questions.explanation: Open Graph (og:title, og:image, og:description) defines the multimedia card displayed on social feeds.

questions.question: What is the standard HTML tag and relation used to declare a browser tab favicon?
questions.explanation: <link rel='icon'> specifies the icon file that browsers render on tabs and bookmarks.
